Dhubri Assam-783301 Ashok Kumar Gupta vs The State Of Assam And 4 Ors on 8 April, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31312067/ 1 Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr. S K Goswami Advocate for the Respondent : Ga, Assam Page Before Honourable Mr. Justice Ujjal Bhuyan Order Date : 08-04-2019
texts.facts: Matter relates to running of a sweet shop in the two storied RCC building belonging to Shri Bangshilal Gupta, father of the petitioner at UNC Road, Ward No.5, Dhubri, which building has been declared to be structurally unfit for running of commercial or any other activity by the office of the Deputy Commissioner, Dhubri as well as by the PWD Building Division. In the inquiry conducted by the office of the Deputy Commissioner, Dhubri, it was found that the said sweet shop is being run by Sri Subhas Gupta in an unauthorized manner without obtaining any license under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
